user_correction: A bag already in the planning list must start its system clock even if it has not yet found a feasible path. Starting only at successful planning hides failed-attempt/retry delay.
primary_formula: For each original business bag, sum each transport leg goal arrival minus first entry to the active planning list (equal to first actual planning attempt in the fixed no-fault comparator).
EBS: Keep the explicit user-confirmed sum of inbound and outbound leg elapsed times; exclude the interval between the two active legs.
HCA_evidence: Frozen ICS appends new_tasks to unfinish then attempts every newly-added item in that epoch; wrapper release.csv release_epoch records this entry. Failed research re-appends the bag; outputstarttime column4 is later success and cannot be the primary THT origin.
G31_change: Native004 records first attempt explicitly. Native003 does not provide this timestamp and cannot be backfilled with generated_release or admission. Source activation is separately recorded because source queues and active planning lists are distinct.
mandatory_components: planning retry hold: admission minus first planning entry
physical in-network elapsed: finish minus admission
preplanning source hold: first planning entry minus canonical release
reporting: All components preserve full canonical population and EBS grouping. A reduced network elapsed alone is not called a THT win.
physics_unchanged: At least2s headway, no internal transport stop, all wait for a certificate occurs before physical conveyor admission. Control-system entry and physical conveyor entry are distinct timestamps.
